title: Stop Saying "Very Sorry"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very sorry". Use one of these words instead:
• Apologetic: He gave an apologetic smile
• Regretful: Now he felt regretful
• Remorseful: He wrote a remorseful note

Comment your own word for "very sorry"!
